subject: ISO/FedRAMP preflight — scope decisions & evidence lane plan
messages:
From: Amelia Carter <amelia.carter@northbridge-sec.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmecloud.com
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Preflight questions: scope + evidence lanes for ISO27001 & FedRAMP

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for taking time to run this preflight. Before we schedule the dry-run, a few quick clarifying questions so we can scope the sampling and reviewers: 

1) Scope boundary: do you expect FedRAMP to require the same service boundary as your ISO scope, or will FedRAMP target a narrower surface (hosted API only)? If narrower, please indicate the services to exclude.
2) Evidence lanes: can you confirm whether logs (API request/response traces), encryption key attestations, and asset inventory are already indexed in a single evidence index or will we receive separate bundles per control family?
3) Snapshot windows: for log sampling do you provide daily snapshots (7/30 day retention) or a point-in-time export? We need to confirm snapshot cadence for extraction scripts.
4) KMS ownership: who is the control owner for key rotation attestations (internal KMS vs. cloud KMS)?

If you can send a short matrix (control -> artifact location -> owner) and one example log export, that would let us size the dry-run. Happy to run a 45-min call next week.

Regards,
Amelia Carter
Senior Auditor — Northbridge Security
[Attachment: audit-preflight-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Carter <amelia.carter@northbridge-sec.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preflight questions: scope + evidence lanes for ISO27001 & FedRAMP

Hi Amelia —

Thanks — quick answers inline and an attached starting artefact: initial-scope-matrix.pdf.

1) Scope boundary: For FedRAMP, we intend to scope to the hosted Redwood API endpoints plus the customer-configurable S3 ingestion path. Our ISO scope is broader (includes internal admin console) — we will mark the admin console as out-of-scope for FedRAMP.

2) Evidence lanes: We are centralizing artifacts in an evidence index (evidence_index.xlsx attached). Logs, encryption attestations, and asset inventory are indexed and reference S3 paths where bundles live. We will export control-specific bundles for your reviewers but the index is the master map.

3) Snapshot windows: We provide daily snapshots for logs with 30-day rolling retention. For the dry-run you should expect point-in-time exports (we'll hand over a 7-day sample).

4) KMS ownership: KMS is customer-managed for hosted customers (cloud KMS), but Redwood holds attestations for rotation for our internal service keys. I'll list the exact control owners in the attached matrix.

Proposed next step: 45-min dry-run on Tue 17 Jun 10:00–10:45 PT. If that works for you we'll prepare a 7-day log sample and the control bundle for the hosted API slice.

Attached: initial-scope-matrix.pdf; evidence_index.xlsx (stub).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Compliance & Controls — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: initial-scope-matrix.pdf (pdf)]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Internal — owners + asks for FedRAMP preflight (please action)

Team —

Copying the thread with Northbridge (Amelia). We committed to a 7-day log sample and a control bundle scoped to Hosted API + S3 ingestion. Action items below; please treat as time-sensitive for Tuesday's dry-run.

Action items:
- Marissa: prepare API request/response trace sample (7 days). Zip and upload to https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-ComplianceEvidence and add path to the evidence_index.xlsx under Logs -> Hosted API. Please include the redaction checklist we use for PII. Owner: marissa_cole. Due: Mon 16 Jun 08:00 PT.
- Priyom: confirm KMS attestations for rotation for the internal service keys and provide the control narrative and rotation logs (last 6 months) to attach. Also annotate whether customer-managed KMS customers have separate artifacts. Owner: priyom_das. Due: Mon 16 Jun 12:00 PT.
- Aditya: inventory export (asset inventory + deployment map) and a short mapping doc that ties services to control families. Add to evidence_index.xlsx under Inventory. Owner: aditya_rao. Due: Mon 16 Jun 10:00 PT.

Notes: we'll include a short 'what to expect' readout at the start of the dry-run to set boundaries (FedRAMP vs ISO) and avoid scope creep. I'll lead the call and surface any escalation items.

Inline from Amelia's mail: "If you can send a short matrix (control -> artifact location -> owner) and one example log export, that would let us size the dry-run." That is exactly what the attachments should look like.

Thanks — let's try to hit these timelines.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Compliance & Controls — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_index.xlsx (stub)]

Laura / team —

Quick update: I uploaded a redacted 7-day trace bundle: log-sample-2025-05.zip to the Drive folder and added the path to evidence_index.xlsx. Redaction: removed user-identifying ids and replaced with deterministic hashes; left request/response timing and headers intact.

KMS: flagged that rotation attestations for internal service keys are in the KMS folder (pri/rotations/). Priyom — can you confirm that the rotation logs you plan to attach contain the key-version history (we need explicit timestamps)?

If anyone hits a blocker on packaging, ping me in #compliance.

Marissa

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the updates and attachments; I can confirm receipt of the evidence_index.xlsx and the log sample. Tue's slot works but note: our reviewers need 24 hours to pre-seed test cases. Can we move the dry-run to Wed 18 Jun 13:00 PT to give them time to ingest the artifacts?

Requested deliverables before the dry-run: consolidated evidence_index.xlsx (with Drive paths populated), KMS rotation logs (timestamped entries), and a single signed control narrative for the Hosted API scope. If you prefer, send a DocuSign link for the signed narrative — that speeds review.

We'll run through a handful of control tests and then give a short readout of findings and any immediate gaps. Looking forward to the run.

Regards,
Amelia Carter
